name: Ichiken Co., Ltd.
summary: Ichiken Co., Ltd. engages in the construction business in Japan. The company is involved in businesses related to architecture, civil engineering, paving, interior finishing work, and other general construction works. It also operates real estate businesses, including housing and commercial facilities sales, leasing and other real estate business activities; engages in planning, designing, and management of complex commercial facilities and specialty stores; and grid storage battery business. Ichiken Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Daiichi Kensetsu Corporation Ltd. and changed its name to Ichiken Co., Ltd. in 1989. The company was incorporated in 1930 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
